headline: Anthropic shares fall below $83, the price of its IPO
summary: Anthropic's shares traded below the $83 IPO price in premarket trading on Tuesday. The decline came days after the Claude developer's record debut on the Nasdaq.
why: Anthropic is a US artificial intelligence developer behind the Claude model. Its share performance after listing is a key test of investor appetite for AI companies.
why_moved: Shares slipped below the $83 offer price in premarket trading, a sharp reversal just days after a record Nasdaq debut.
original_headline: Acciones de Anthropic caen por debajo de los 83 dólares, el precio de su salida a bolsa
